Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 rules - consent of OpenPeppol AISBL

The Peppol-specific rules of Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 are the work of OpenPeppol AISBL, Brussels, which holds their
copyright. OpenPeppol AISBL publishes them without a licence, and the BIS document allows redistribution only with its
prior consent. OpenPeppol AISBL has given that consent for the rule packages of VAMPIRE, which contain these rules
translated into the rule format of the engine; they are not the original Schematron files.

The consent covers every package that carries these rules, also on public validation pages. invoicePress grants no
licence of its own to this material, and the rights stay with OpenPeppol AISBL.

Source: https://github.com/OpenPEPPOL/peppol-bis-invoice-3
